User.title: User
User.description: User profile with authentication info, email or phone, and session state.

phoneNumber.description: Verified phone number formatted in E.164

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the user registered

lastLoginAt.description: ISO timestamp of most recent login

UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: Cross-browser persistent settings including theme, indicators, drawings, layout, and alerts.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user

hiddenIndicators.description: IDs of indicators temporarily toggled off

savedScripts.description: Custom indicator and Pine scripts created by user

chartSettings.description: Custom candlestick colors, grid lines, volume visibility, and scale precision

drawings.description: Technical analysis drawings and annotations placed on charts

alerts.description: User price alerts with trigger conditions

savedLayouts.description: Saved multi-chart and workspace layout templates

currentLayoutName.description: Name of the currently loaded chart layout

activePanel.description: Last active sidebar panel if any

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the settings were last synced

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profile data accessible only by the authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/settings/{settingId}.description: Stores cross-browser synchronized chart preferences, indicators, drawings, and alerts.
